# SCHEMA

## Domain

bread-baking — concepts, entities and comparisons related to baking bread
with commercial yeast or a naturally leavened starter.

## Tags

- `baking` — the craft of mixing, fermenting and baking a dough.
- `fermentation` — yeast and bacterial activity that leavens a dough.
- `hydration` — the ratio of water to flour in a dough.
- `method` — a named way of organising a bake, such as an autolyse.
- `equipment` — the tools and vessels a bake passes through.
- `ingredients` — the raw materials a dough or starter is made from.
- `technique` — a hands-on skill applied at one particular stage.
- `storage` — keeping baked bread or shaped dough in good condition.

## Conventions

- Filenames are lowercase-hyphen.md.
- Every page carries at least two outbound [[wikilinks]].
- Claims drawn from a raw source carry a `^[raw/...]` provenance marker.
- Pages over 200 lines are split candidates.
